# Axogen, Inc. to Participate in Multiple Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 03, 2026 7:00am EST


ALACHUA, Fla. and TAMPA, Fla., Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Axogen, Inc. (Nasdaq: AXGN), a global leader in developing and marketing innovative surgical solutions for the restoration of peripheral nerve function, today announced that management is scheduled to participate in three upcoming investor conferences:


**Canaccord Genuity 20** **th** **Annual MedTech, Diagnostics, Digital Health & Services Forum**
Participation: Fireside Chat and 1x1 investor meetings
Date/Time: Fireside Chat Wednesday, November 11, 2026, 10:00 AM ET


**Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London**
Participation: Fireside Chat and 1x1 investor meetings
Date/Time: Fireside Chat Tuesday, November 17, 2026, 8:30 AM ET


**Piper Sandler 38** **th** **Annual Healthcare Conference**
Participation: Presentation and 1x1 investor meetings
Date/Time: Presentation Wednesday, December 2, 2026, 8:00 AM ET

**About Axogen**


Axogen (Nasdaq: AXGN) is focused on the science, development and commercialization of technologies for peripheral nerve repair. With a mission to make nerve repair the expected standard of care, Axogen advances the field through research, education, and collaboration with surgeons and healthcare providers across a global network.


Axogen’s product portfolio includes Avance® (acellular nerve allograft-arwx), Avance® Nerve Graft, Axoguard Nerve Connector®, Axoguard Nerve Protector®, Axoguard HA+ Nerve Protector™, Axoguard Nerve Cap®, Avive+ Soft Tissue Matrix™, and NerveTape®.
